result.markdown:
If you mean **lawyers representing patients/ families in medical negligence claims** (rather than defending doctors or hospitals), the strongest Melbourne shortlist I found is based primarily on the **2026 Doyle’s Guide rankings**, lawyer recognition, and specialist credentials.

### My shortlist

1. **Maurice Blackburn Personal Injury Lawyers Melbourne** — **Tom Ballantyne** is ranked *Preeminent* in Doyle’s 2026 Victorian medical-negligence plaintiff rankings. Maurice Blackburn is also ranked **First Tier** as a firm. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   - Another Melbourne medical-negligence specialist is **Samuel Pearce**, a Law Institute of Victoria Accredited Specialist in Personal Injury Law. [www.mauriceblackburn.com.au](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/our-lawyers/samuel-pearce/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

2. **Slater and Gordon Lawyers** — **Naty Guerrero-Diaz** and **Shari Liby** are both ranked *Leading* in the 2026 Doyle’s Guide, while the firm is **First Tier**. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

3. **Arnold Thomas & Becker Lawyers Melbourne** — **Emily Hart** is ranked *Preeminent*, and the firm is **Second Tier** in the 2026 plaintiff medical-negligence rankings. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

4. **Brave Legal** — **Bree Knoester** is ranked *Leading* by Doyle’s. Best Lawyers also recognises her for medical negligence, and she has substantial personal-injury experience. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.bestlawyers.com](https://www.bestlawyers.com/australia/melbourne/medical-negligence?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

5. **Shine Lawyers Melbourne** — **Daniel Opare** is Deputy Head of Medical Law nationally and is a LIV Accredited Specialist in Personal Injury Law. He has been recognised by Doyle’s as a Leading Medical Negligence Compensation Lawyer. [www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/meet-the-team/daniel-opare?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

6. **Polaris Lawyers** — The firm is **Second Tier** in Doyle’s 2026 Victorian plaintiff medical-negligence rankings, making it another worthwhile specialist option. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### If it were my case

I'd probably get **2–3 initial consultations**, starting with:

- **Maurice Blackburn / Tom Ballantyne** — particularly for a serious or catastrophic injury.
- **Arnold Thomas & Becker / Emily Hart** — particularly if you want a highly ranked specialist at a dedicated plaintiff firm.
- **Slater & Gordon** — strong option with a substantial medical-negligence practice.
- **Brave Legal / Bree Knoester** — attractive if you prefer a smaller specialist practice.
- **Shine / Daniel Opare** — worth considering for a complex medical-law matter.

Doyle's 2026 rankings are especially useful here because its plaintiff medical-negligence list identifies lawyers based on feedback from **defendant-side insurance lawyers**, rather than simply relying on consumer reviews. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.bestlawyers.com](https://www.bestlawyers.com/australia/melbourne/medical-negligence?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**One important point:** a good medical-negligence lawyer should assess not just whether the treatment was poor, but whether there was a legally actionable breach of the required standard of care, causation, and compensable loss. In Victoria, limitation periods can also be important, so I wouldn't delay getting advice.

The **Law Institute of Victoria** also provides a lawyer-referral service and a directory of Accredited Specialists. [www.liv.asn.au](https://www.liv.asn.au/asdirectory?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **what happened (e.g. misdiagnosis, surgical error, delayed diagnosis, birth injury, medication error, death)** and roughly **when it happened**, I can narrow this down to the **3 best Melbourne lawyers for your particular type of claim**, including their experience, fees/no-win-no-fee arrangements, reviews and contact details.
